name: Drawer
label: Drawer
description: An edge-anchored modal panel that slides in from any side, for filter panels, detail views, and mobile navigation.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the drawer requests to close

props.name: title
props.description:
Drawer title.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which Drawer does not expose.

props.name: heading
props.description:
Content shown in place of the title text, such as a site's logo. The
`title` still names the dialog, read by assistive tech from a visually
hidden heading.

props.name: footer
props.description: Optional footer slot — typically a row of Buttons

props.name: side
props.description:
Edge the panel slides in from. `left` and `right` are the screen's
edges in any reading direction; `start` and `end` follow it, so a
`start` drawer opens on the left in English and on the right in Arabic.

props.name: size
props.description: Panel size along the axis it slides on

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether ESC, scrim click, and the close button can dismiss

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes — applied to the portal container, not the panel
